title: Stub evaluator diagnosis channel (F4)
description:
## Finding F4 (Council: P1, 90% confidence)

When LlmEvaluatorImpl.EvaluateAsync returns ShouldReplan=true with a Reason/Suggestion, the dispatch loop only logs it and breaks out. IPlanner.PlanAsync has no parameter for the evaluator's diagnosis — the only call site passes just goal and state. The stall-path variant sends evalResult.Suggestion to in-game chat but never reaches any IGoalDecomposer or LLM planning fallback prompt.

## Effect
Since goal identity and WorldState are frequently unchanged at replan time, calling PlanAsync again with the same inputs regenerates the same plan. The replan-governor's fingerprint check detects the repeat and returns STALLED. Structural loop: evaluator says "replan, try X" → planner has no way to attempt X → governor detects repeat → handler asks LLM again → same loop.

## Recommendation (Sprint 59: Stub)
1. Add `EvaluationResult.Diagnosis` field (string)
2. Populate it in LlmEvaluatorImpl from the evaluator's Reason/Suggestion
3. Store it on the goal object when replanning
Full consumption in PlannerRouter deferred to Sprint 60.
